what.text: This page follows refugees from Guinea living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6690 Guinean refugees in Germany, 14.0% of all refugees from Guinea.
France hosts the most Guinean refugees, followed by Germany, Belgium and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Guinea with the RFDG in 2000 and 2001.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Guinea.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 703 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2021 and 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
